items.topic: Keycloak client redirectUris must include every origin that hosts a page using it
items.claim: Login from LAN URL gave 'Invalid redirect URI'; client dashboard-web only allowed localhost/127.0.0.1.
items.fact: Keycloak client `dashboard-web` (realm pi-identity) must list each external origin (LAN IP http://192.168.10.219:8010/*, Tailscale 100.74.191.63, and later review app :8791/*) in redirectUris. Fix both live via admin API (PUT client -> HTTP 204) and in realm-blueprint.json so it survives rebuilds. Issuer/redirects are pinned to the Mac's LAN IP; must be updated if the IP changes.

items.topic: Review site merge: periodic always-on auto-sync, not a button
items.claim: Agent proposed manual 'Merge my decisions' button (recommended).
items.fact: Operator: 'Noo do it periodically so we can see both changes synced! always'. Server merges every reviewer's per-user store (review-state.<user>.json) into shared view every 15s; pages refresh every 15s; disagreement => conflict flag keeping all votes; agreement => decision set.

items.topic: Reviewer AI sessions had no way to record decisions
items.claim: SKILL.md told reviewer AIs to append to suggestions-<you>.md in their own /work/<name> copy; nothing read that file.
items.fact: Operator asked 'the session does not have a tool to update decisions from the ai why?'. Cause: skill pointed to a file nothing consumed; sessions have only bash/read; workspace copies are separate from the site data. Fix: review-decide.mjs (whoami | list [--undecided] | set <id> <accept|needs-change|defer|reject> [note]) logs in with the reviewer's own .review-login.json and posts to the site API so decision lands in the user's store.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-06T12:56 operator; agent verified via docker compose exec

items.topic: Review site must be user-bound and token-gated
items.fact: Operator: 'add periodic merge and user bound sites! only accessible with the same login token!' Implemented: all /api/* (chat, downloads, data) require a valid Keycloak bearer token verified server-side; per-user stores; chat author taken from login; existing shared review-state.json became store 'operator' (counted as a vote).

items.topic: No second login: reuse existing Keycloak SSO session
items.claim: Agent built a username/password sign-in form on the review page.
items.fact: Operator: 'Should not ask! Should use the same Keycloak endpoint! No other login is needed if someone has already logged in into the dashboard in the same keycloak and same browser!' Agent switched to Keycloak authorization-code + PKCE flow with silent prompt=none check, server-side endpoints (/api/auth-config, /api/auth-start, code exchange), PKCE verifier kept on server because LAN pages are not a secure context (no WebCrypto).

items.topic: Browser SSO cookies are per host: localhost login does not apply to LAN IP
items.fact: Keycloak session cookies are per host, so a dashboard login on localhost does not give silent SSO on http://192.168.10.219:8791; the user must log in once via the LAN-address dashboard. Silent check must retry on each load (a sessionStorage 'silentTried' flag blocked retries and was removed).

Keycloak realm accessTokenLifespan is 5 minutes; the page refreshes tokens in background. Dashboard accepts the Keycloak bearer from the LAN. Reviewer workspaces run as same system user, so they are not a security boundary (one AI could read another's .review-login.json).

items.topic: Reviewer container has Node, not Python; sessions end on restart
items.claim: First CLI tool was written in python3.
items.fact: pi-dashboard container has no python3 (only Node), so tools for reviewer AIs must be .mjs (review-decide.mjs). After `docker compose up -d --build`, old reviewer sessions are 'ended' and keep the old baked skill; spawn-reviewers.sh skipped anyone with any session on record, so it was changed to count only non-ended sessions. Skill changes require rebuild image + fresh sessions; /work/<user>/.pi/skills/blueprint-review copies must be re-synced.

items.topic: Sandbox hooks block inline curl; browser caching
items.fact: The shell tool blocks raw curl output ('use context-mode tools instead'); run HTTP checks as python scripts. Browser tests show stale pages: append a changing ?v=xyz query to the URL. agent-browser refs change after each snapshot, re-snapshot before fill/click. A kb guard nags 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult' – run kb_search.

server.py route /api/download?path=<repo-relative .md>[&as=decisions] returns Content-Disposition attachment; path traversal and non-.md paths return 404; later requires token and per-user decisions file review-decisions.<user>.md.
